source.subject: Arts
source.extractionPreview:
11
DANCE VOCABULARY 
AND TECHNIQUES
Nritta, Nritya and Natya
Dance comprises many units which are beautifully connected together. 
Some have joyous movements, some narrate a story or a situation and 
some tell the full story. Below are the definitions of nritta, nritya and 
natya given from the treatise, Abhinaya Darpana, a text widely followed 
by classical dancers.
नृत्तं - भाावााभि�नयहीीनं तु नृत्तमििœत्यभि�धीीयते ॥ १५॥
nṛttah bhāvābhinayahīnam tu nṛttamityabhidhīyate
Nritta consists of dance
